subject: integration
name: Saved passwords standard (PASSWORD_0_1)
summary: A definition of PASSWORD_0_1, marked browser-only so no page can ask for it. Groups list (risk 4), reveal (risk 9) and keep (risk 6) give the browser's own password code listForSite, reveal (a user name and password), save and remove, all through an Account. The definition says reveal answers only for the origin a login is saved under; it cannot check that an Account holds to that, or what an Account does with a password that save hands it. The row has no code, address or request. Level 4 with privacy as a definition. Judged here by its publisher.
